text.tspan: Primary energy from fossil fuels, nuclear, and renewables World
Measured as a percentage of total energy supply. Renewables include hydropower, solar, wind, geothermal,
bioenergy, and waste, but not traditional biomass.

tspan.tspan: Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2026); Smil (2017); U.S. Energy Information Administration (2026)
